name: Stella Fons
source:
The top ranked fighter in the arena.

A plucky girl who is a skilled swordsman, she registered as a bounty hunter and quickly rose to prominence due to her young age. 

Her beautiful face and shapely body, combined with her immense strength, made her the symbol of the arena.
